title: Velvety Peruvian Fromage Frais Gratin
description: A creamy, briny twist on a classic Peruvian dish, adapted for a dairy-free lifestyle. Perfect for kids and a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: Combine fromage frais, queso fresco, cilantro, onion, and pepper in a blender or food processor until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and heat over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Add boiling water to achieve the desired consistency (a velvety, pourable sauce).
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the sauce to a baking dish and top with additional queso fresco and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden brown.
Serve warm or chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Note: For a dairy-free version, use a non-dairy milk and omit the queso fresco, or substitute with a dairy-free cheese alternative.
If using a dairy-free milk, you may need to adjust the amount of thickening agents (such as cornstarch or tapioca starch) to achieve the desired consistency.
